product_metadata.title: Comfort Glow EMF160 Mini Hearth Electric Fireplace, Wood Grain 4100 BTUs
features: Real flame technology provides realistic dancing flame and flickering ember bed
Built in blower circulates 4,100 BTU's throughout the area being heated
Heating Area: Up to 250 sq ft - Manual Temperature Control
Real flame technology provides realistic dancing flame and flickering ember bed
description: The world's smallest electric fireplace! The mini hearth from Comfort Glow is just 10" tall, but powerful enough to gently warm a 250 sq. ft. room. Small enough to fit on any desk, bookshelf, entertainment center, or night stand, it will still be the focal point of any room you place it in. The beautiful wood grain finish is sure to accent any home decor and the Real Flame™ technology gives you that authentic-looking fireplace glow with a realistic dancing flame and flickering ember bed. The built-in blower circulates warm air throughout the area being heated. A flame only setting gives you the flame effect without the heat - allowing this unit to be enjoyed year-round.
